## Purpose
Checks that credentials never reach Mistral observability and that the Logs page never shows sign-in traces. No Mistral calls.

## Behaviour pinned down
- **Scrubbing:** `scrub` masks secret fields at any depth; `is_private_path` identifies the private paths.
- **Private requests and spans:**
  - sign-in requests run private;
  - a private context opens no app span;
  - the exporter drops private spans;
  - the tagger marks spans started inside a private scope.
- **The Logs page:**
  - hides sign-in traces;
  - masks old request bodies.
- **Audit:** the auth category and event detail.
- **Logs and activity:**
  - action search keeps root spans only;
  - activity logs merge workspaces and name people.

## Fixtures, mocks and external dependencies
- **`_call` helper:** runs one POST through `ActionTracingMiddleware`.
- **Stubbed:** the span and trace payloads.

## How to run
`python -m pytest tests/test_observability_privacy.py -q`.

None.
